verdict.rationale: Morph serves open-weight models behind OpenAI-compatible and native Anthropic Messages endpoints. Its docs say you can migrate production agents onto Kimi K3, and that Claude Code, a tool-heavy agent loop, can run against `/v1/messages`. Together these imply working tool calling on open models, but no doc states function/tool-calling support or its fidelity. Missing for 10: explicit tool/function-calling documentation, parallel tool call support, multi-step tool loop guarantees, hands-on or independent corroboration of tool-call reliability on open models.
